name: Container app
summary: Serverless container for an API, web app or background worker with autoscaling, managed identity image pull and Key Vault secrets.
useWhen: You want to run a container without managing Kubernetes
You need scale to zero or event-driven scaling
You need a worker process with no HTTP endpoint
avoidWhen: You need full Kubernetes APIs, custom operators or daemon sets (use AKS)
You need a multi-container pod with a shared volume beyond sidecars
